title: Sixty-hour momentum sign with a rising-bar trigger, closed each evening

source.title: Time Series Momentum (Moskowitz, Ooi, Pedersen), via lab hypothesis H-016

rule_summary: Hourly chart, decisions at bar close, fills at the next open. Buy when the close is higher than the close sixty bars earlier and also higher than the previous bar, with nothing open and two bars elapsed after the last sale. Sell when the close drops to or under its level sixty bars earlier. Protective stop two percent under the fill. Entries only for bars opening 00:00 to 16:00 UTC, at most two per pair per UTC day; whatever is still open is sold at the 23:00 UTC open or twelve bars after the purchase, whichever is first.
mechanism: Sign of the recent return persists for hours (the parent used thirty days; sixty hours is that divided by twelve). Slow capital keeps buying a rising asset, so the next hours lean up while the sign holds. Expected gross move about 0.6% on winners against a 2% stop; a design estimate, not a result.
